capabilities: insert a dated weekly template from the command palette
pick a week of the year from a dropdown labelled with date ranges
toggle the week start day between Monday and Sunday
preview the generated markdown before inserting
set a persistent default start day in settings
disambiguation: Not a weekly planner or calendar view; it only inserts static Markdown for one chosen week at the cursor.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later; installation is manual from a release or from source.
problem: Obsidian templates don't generate dated weekly structures with per-day headings and task checkboxes, so weekly planning notes must be written out by hand.
summary: Weekly template plugin that inserts a dated week layout with a heading and unticked checkbox for each weekday at the cursor.
